text:
alex: kicking off RC creation for service-scribe -> v2.3.1-rc4. target promo window 02:00-03:00 UTC. plan: small traffic hysteresis (start 1%, +1% every 3m) up to 10%. artifact sha=abcd1234. db-migration: none. canary region: us-west1. pinging @sheriff_jamie for oncall cover.
maya: running quick smoke now. `./scripts/smoke.sh service-scribe v2.3.1-rc4` — all tests green locally. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [build] artifact pushed: `service-scribe:v2.3.1-rc4` sha=abcd1234. container registry push complete.
alex: confirmation: we will keep rollback thresholds strict — error rate +2% absolute or p99 latency >250ms for 5m -> immediate rollback to v2.3.0. will open incident if triggered.
sheriff_jamie: ack. i'll mute non-critical alerts for the window and watch the dashboard.
nora: ops note — KV cache warm required. i'll kick the warming job 15m before promo and report readiness.
maya: also pinning model variant to `quantized-8` in runtime config to avoid mem regressions. config update ready.
ops-bot: scheduled promo job for 2026-03-15T02:05:00Z (job id 78901). ETA ~5m at start.
deploy-bot: [deploy] promote job 78901 started. applying routing and canary rules. canary traffic: 1% -> 5 nodes. logs: `[INFO] route-updates applied`.
alex: keep ramp conservative. do not exceed 5% without explicit signoff. if we see any error spike, cut traffic and rollback.
maya: running post-deploy smoke and short eval on our prompt set now. will report regressions.
sheriff_jamie: rollback playbook ready. if needed, i'll run `promote --rollback-to v2.3.0 --job 78901` and notify SRE/PM.
nora: warming job finished. KV hit ratio ~98%, TTLs look healthy.
deploy-bot: canary stable at 1% for 10m, monitoring OK. ready to proceed with ramp.
alex: promote to 5% now.
deploy-bot: traffic set to 5%. metrics snapshot: p50 40ms, p95 120ms, p99 210ms, errors 0.04%.
maya: post-ramp checks passing, no regression on eval suite. approve next ramp to 20%?
alex: hold for additional 10m to observe p99 tail. if stable, ramp rules: +5% every 2m until 20%.
sheriff_jamie: watching the dashboards, will call rollback if thresholds breached.
ops-bot: reminder: change window ends 03:00 UTC. any manual hold -> annotate job 78901 with `hold_reason`.
(threads: small notifications and short follow-ups as deployment proceeds)
_meta: Generated slack thread for RC creation, sign-off, and staged promotion with traffic hysteresis and rollback criteria.
